output_boundary: aggregate-only work order; no audio IDs, transcripts, hypotheses, or reviewer notes
reference_transcript_policy: Reference transcripts are already human-reviewed ground truth for WER/CER scoring; this packet does not ask for duplicate transcript review unless future review fields or content differ from the accepted ground-truth transcript fields.
remaining_review_scope: The packet asks reviewers to complete risk atoms, decision-change labels, expected safe action, confidence, per-model assessment fields, and per-row review timing.

current_step.completion_signal: review_started_at is present for every model row in this selected row
current_step.privacy_boundary: tracked command only; local response TSV remains ignored

next_local_row_step.completion_signal: reviewer has inspected the local row without copying content into git
next_local_row_step.privacy_boundary: command output is transcript-bearing and must stay local-only

next_reviewer_operation.note: Run current_step first. If current_step is mark_timing_start, then open next_local_row_step locally; command output is transcript-bearing and must not be copied into tracked files.

next_concrete_action: Use the work-order TSV during local review: start timing, inspect one local row, fill row/model fields, finish timing, then run strict dry-run, closeout, and the post-review sequence runner.
